description: Reconciliation between the census's production paths and the completeness capability map (capabilities.json). Every census production path is either mapped (the capability map owns it and selects a rule family for it) or explicitly declared unmapped with a rationale and an owning issue. The census validator fails when a mapped declaration stops matching the map or an unmapped declaration silently becomes mapped, so mapping rot is noisy in both directions.

unmapped_production_paths.rationale: Parser source is a production path the current capability map does not list; the selector's production-path map is owned by the presubmit-selector workstream.
Parser type-record source is a production path the current capability map does not list; the selector's production-path map is owned by the presubmit-selector workstream.
Script-class and member-binding source is a production path the current capability map does not list; the selector's production-path map is owned by the presubmit-selector workstream.
Compiled-bytecode export is a production path the current capability map does not list; serialization ownership is scoped by the serialization workstream.
Compiled-bytecode load/reload is a production path the current capability map does not list; serialization ownership is scoped by the serialization workstream.

The engine-level container descriptor lives outside the foundry_script module root the current capability map covers; extending the map beyond the module is a selector-workstream specification change.
